clue.text: Smashing rinse 'n' go places

clue.text: Run out interminable chatter of a canon

clue.text: Outburst on the subject of offensive scenario

clue.text: Ancient tribe is perhaps brash by way of moving north

clue.text: Head with backbone connects basic facts

parts.note: taken as written

clue.text: Handle danger following hospital's discharge

clue.text: In Thailand old hunter adopts name for block

stock in the sense of lineage or breed

clue.text: Pretty Woman, that one behind Roy's first, a hit finally

clue.text: We measure a surprising surge after close of voting

taken as written, to be rearranged
